<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/plugins/{id}/image"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Plugin views may only show pictures from the plugin's own assets, so a picture from elsewhere comes through here. Only for a running plugin with network:outbound or network:sockets granted. The answer is the picture itself; anything that is not an image, over 5 MB, on this machine or at a cloud metadata address is refused.
